scripts.android:debug: npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.ios:open: npm run build && cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.ios:simulator: npm run build && cap sync ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Debug build
